sokkel-egui.note: Drawn from the spec: a control only with href or onSelect, the title cap, the menu, selected, status, description and the facts' fit.

sokkel-tui.note: Not in sokkel-tui's reports as of b99664f.

summary: The card for one thing: a project, a job, an album, a plan. Its title is the thing's name, or its code when it has none, the code drawn once in the code face. An icon on a tile may lead the title; a status, a description and facts at the foot follow, and media such as artwork may sit on top. Given href or onSelect the whole card is one control; selected marks the chosen card of a set, and a menu sits at the head's end as its own control.

anatomy.card: The card: a column on card with a border-strong edge, rounded by radius-surface, text.sm in card-foreground. With href or onSelect the whole card is one control under its pieces.
anatomy.media: With media: drawn edge to edge at the top, 16 by 9, on muted; in a box of fixed height it gives up height first.
anatomy.body: The head, the status and the description, padded 16, 8 apart.
anatomy.head: The icon's tile, the heading, the selected check and the menu in a row, 8 apart, set at the top.
anatomy.icon: With icon: a 32 tile on muted, rounded by radius-lg, 4 more before the heading, its glyph 16 in foreground.
anatomy.heading: The thing's heading as ItemHeading draws it at panel size: its name, else its code in the code face, the code under the name when both are given; up to titleLines lines, its whole text on hover when cut.
anatomy.check: While selected: a 20 circle in primary with a check, 14, in primary-foreground.
anatomy.menu: With menu: a 28 square button at the head's end, a dot-dot-dot, 16, in muted-foreground, opening parts/dropdown-menu at its end, 176 wide. It is its own control, over the card's.
anatomy.status: With status: its chips and words in a row that wraps, 8 apart, text.xs in muted-foreground.
anatomy.description: With description: up to three lines in muted-foreground.
anatomy.facts: With facts: the card's foot behind a border rule, padded 16 across and 10 down, as many columns as fit (each at least 80), 12 apart: each fact's label in text.xs and muted-foreground over its value in text.sm in tabular figures, each cut to one line.

title.does: The name; with none, the code is the title.

code.does: The thing's addressable code, drawn once in the code face.

description.does: Up to three lines about it.

icon.does: A glyph on a tile of its own before the title, saying what kind of thing the card is.

media.does: Drawn edge to edge at the top: artwork, a preview.

status.does: Chips and words in a row under the head.

facts.does: The card's foot: each { label, value }.

menu.does: Dropdown menu items behind the head's more button.

href.does: The whole card is a link to it.

onSelect.does: The whole card is a button that calls this.

selected.does: Marks the chosen card when the cards are a set to choose from.

titleLines.does: How many lines the title may take before it is cut short: 1, 2 or 3.

factMin.note: A fact's column is at least this wide; the foot fits as many as its width holds.

hover.means: The pointer is over a card that is a control: washed, its edge firmer.
hover.reached: pointer over, with href or onSelect

focus.means: Keyboard focus on the card: the focus outline around it.

selected.means: The chosen card of a set: a primary edge with a 1px primary ring, and the check in the head.

focus.note: The outline is the card's cover's, drawn around the card.

keyboard.does: Reaches the card when it is a control, then its menu.

sokkel-ui: The card is an article; with href or onSelect a link or a button covers it (its name the heading), and every piece over it but the menu lets the pointer through.
The facts are a description list (dl) in a grid of auto-fit columns.

drift.today: As of b99664f its reports name no such part.
